text: Lexus is Toyota Motor Corporation's luxury-car brand: per Toyota's FY2026 Form 20-F, its luxury cars are sold primarily under the Lexus brand name.
short: Lexus is a brand of Toyota Motor Corporation

source.name: Toyota Motor Corporation Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: Toyota’s luxury cars are sold in North America, Europe, Japan and other regions, primarily under the Lexus brand name
